==Information==
<big>This page classifies different units to different ranks depending on how good they are in '''Infinity Castle'''

'''Units are ranked based on the following statistics:'''
*'''DPS'''(Damage Per Second) 
*'''TDPS'''(Total Damage Per Second) 
*'''SPA'''(Second Per Attack) 
*'''AoE'''(Area of Effect) 
*'''(as well as many other properties of a unit; Cost, Abilities, Effects, etc)'''
The ranking of each unit is based on how well they preform on each map in infinity castle
'''This tier list ranks units based on their base stats, and their potential including buffs, supports, and relics.'''
'''This tier list IS BASED ON TRAITLESS UNITS, NOT UNIQUE. Most of the units in the top of each tier happen to be the best for castle with unique as well.'''
</big>

{{TierList/Item|Orwin
|Description={{Meta Support Unit}}<br>
Orwin is cheap to place and has an ability that increases the physical damage of allies in range. He gives a 25% damage increase to physical units and you can cycle these buffs to reach up to a 100% damage increase on physical units. Orwin also has the '''BUFF''' tag, making it a perfect partner for '''Griffin(Acension)''' to reach his '''Griffin(Reincarnation)''' form, allowing you to reach a 3.5x damage increase.<br>
----
'''Placement Cost:''' {{Yen|775}}<br>
----
'''Placements: 6'''
----
Recommended Traits:  [[Image:Trait Sniper.png|18px]] [[Image:Trait Divine.png|18px]] [[Image:Trait Range.png|18px]]
}}

{{TierList/Item|Leafy (Sylph)
|Description={{Meta Support Unit}}<br>
Leafy is cheap to place and has an ability that increases the magic damage of allies in range. She gives a 50% damage increase to magic units and you can cycle these buffs to reach up to a 100% damage increase on magic units. Leafy also has the '''BUFF tag''', making it a perfect partner for '''Griffin(Acension)''' to reach his '''Griffin(Reincarnation)''' form, allowing you to reach a 4x damage increase.
----
'''Placement Cost:''' {{Yen|1K}}<br>
----
'''Placements: 6'''
}}

{{TierList/Item|Oshy (Idol)
|Description={{Meta Support Unit}}<br>
On placement, Oshy (Idol) increases the damage of all of the owner's units by 5%, and reduces their cost by 5%. Each upgrade, the discount and damage percent increases (-10% cost, +7% dmg upg 1, -15% cost +10% dmg upg 2, -20% cost +15% dmg upg 3). With the Golden trait, every Oshy upgrade reduces cost by an extra 1%.
----
'''Placement Cost:''' {{Yen|1K}} - '''Cost to Max:''' {{Yen|16K}}<br>
----
'''Placements: 1'''
----
Recommended Traits: [[Image:Trait Golden.png|18px]]
}}

<br>
'''DPS''' Calculations are based off of DMG (Damage) of the unit divided by SPA (Attack Speed) of the unit, and only considers '''One Placement'''.
          
'''TDPS''' Calculations are based same calculations as '''DPS''', but considers the '''Maximum Placements''' a character can have. 

The Total '''DPS/TDPS''' of a unit can be higher or lower based on '''Passive Abilities'''(like Gyutaru(Moon)), or abilities that cause DMG (Anz(Overlord)) or (Julio(Wizard King))
